description: Black Market: prepare (unsigned) opening a crate you hold. One step: the open call burns the crate and pays its prize (an Armory weapon, a bundle of 3 Dispensary items, or rarely the Okami) to you; the prize was fixed by a public drand draw published about 30 seconds after the event ended, so there is no second reveal step once the draw is posted. Refused while the crate is still sealed (with the wait), if you do not hold it, or if it was already opened. If the draw's round has passed but is not yet posted on chain, pass drandSignature (drand's 48 byte signature for that round) to post it in the same call. Costs only gas.

contractSet.description: Optional: "v2" (live Games Master v2 contracts) or "legacy" (retired original Season 1 contracts). Only needed if you hold the same id in both; otherwise v2 is tried first, then legacy.

crateId.description: The crate token id (my_shop_items lists yours).

drandSignature.description: Optional: 0x plus 96 hex characters, only needed when the draw is passed but not yet posted.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_open_crate
